say:20:1011512008:0.source_cn: 他已经有人望，有可操控的武力，有备受尊崇的地位。

say:21:1011512009:0.text: Once the truth is revealed, that will tarnish his reputation and he'll lose everything.
say:21:1011512009:0.source_cn: 真相一旦败露，他反而会身败名裂，一无所有。

say:22:1011512010:0.text: Does he want to get rid of the faction system and control the Dark Forest by himself?!
say:22:1011512010:0.source_cn: 那老头，难道看不惯三派共治，想把薄暮丛林的一切都掌握在...

choice_prompt:23:1011512010.text: Does he want to get rid of the faction system and control the Dark Forest by himself?!
choice_prompt:23:1011512010.source_cn: 那老头，难道看不惯三派共治，想把薄暮丛林的一切都掌握在自己手里吗？！

say:24:1011512012:0.text: That traitor! If only we had found out what he was doing earlier...!
say:24:1011512012:0.source_cn: 混蛋！要是我们早一点发现他在干什么就好了！！

say:26:1011512013:1.text: Lorsan, this is not the time for self-doubt. Nobody could have predicted Eomir's betrayal.
say:26:1011512013:1.source_cn: 洛桑，现在不是自艾自怜的时候，伊米尔会做出这种事情，任...

say:27:1011512014:1.text: What we need to do now is pull ourselves together.
say:27:1011512014:1.source_cn: 我们现在能做的，是要打起精神。

say:28:1011512015:1.text: We're the only ones who know the truth and can stop Eomir!
say:28:1011512015:1.source_cn: 知晓阴谋，而且能够阻止伊米尔的，只有我们！

say:31:1011512017:1.text: Right... But I can't figure out why Eomir would corrupt the forest.
say:31:1011512017:1.source_cn: 嗯，但不知道伊米尔腐化丛林的动机究竟为何……

say:32:1011512018:1.text: I've marked down the corrupted spot here. What's our next move? Shall we proceed to the Lucent Tree?
say:32:1011512018:1.source_cn: 这处腐化地点已记录下来。后续我们要如何行动？要继续前往...

say:33:1011512019:0.text: Look! There's something coming at us!
say:33:1011512019:0.source_cn: 等一下，你们看——有东西飞过来了！

cinematic_dialogue:36:1011513002:.text: And a message leaf from Bryon...

cinematic_dialogue:36:1011513003:.text: He wants us to meet him at the dock!
cinematic_dialogue:36:1011513003:.source_cn: 让我们去前面的码头找他！

narration:38:10115342:0.text: Elona brings a message leaf from Bryon. It instructs you to find him at the nearby docks.
narration:38:10115342:0.source_cn: 艾洛娜捎来了布莱恩的叶信，让你们去前面的码头找他。

choice:15:0:1.text: That's also toward the Lucent Tree.
choice:15:0:1.source_cn: 果然也指向流荧树的方向
choice:15:0:1.male: That's also toward the Lucent Tree.
choice:15:0:1.female: That's also toward the Lucent Tree.

narration:40:10115341:0.text: You use your magic to temporarily cleanse the corruption in this area.
narration:40:10115341:0.source_cn: 你使用魔法，暂时清除了这里的腐化。

say:0:1011514001:0.source_cn: 布莱恩的信上还说了什么？

say:1:1011514002:0.text: Nothing, he just said it was urgent.
say:1:1011514002:0.male: Nothing, he just said it was urgent.
say:1:1011514002:0.female: Nothing, he just said it was urgent.

say:2:1011514003:0.text: He could've just told me through the wind...
say:2:1011514003:0.source_cn: 真是的，布莱恩那家伙，有事用风讯联络不就好了……

say:0:1011515001:0.text: The dock is right around the corner.

say:1:1011515002:0.text: You can look out over the Lucent Tree on the dock...
say:1:1011515002:0.source_cn: 站在码头上，可以遥望到流荧树……

say:2:1011515003:0.text: The Lucent Tree... What an unforgivable crime the Thorned Guards have done!
say:2:1011515003:0.source_cn: 流荧树……荆棘……他们到底做了多么罪无可恕的事！

say:2:1011517001:0.text: The corrupted roots near Lunadorf exhibit signs of resurgence. Any advancements from your endeavors?
say:2:1011517001:0.source_cn: 月湖村附近的腐化根茎又有复生趋势，不知诸位有什么进展？

say:3:1011517002:0.text: Bryon, we found the real culprit behind the corruption...
say:3:1011517002:0.source_cn: 布莱恩，我们发现了在丛林散播腐化的……真凶。

say:4:1011517003:0.text:
It's Eomir...
We found out he was working with the Adamant Syndicate. And their ultimate target is...
say:4:1011517003:0.source_cn: ——伊米尔。\n我们发现他在和外界的黑金商会合作。而他...

say:8:1011517006:2.text: Master Arden, prior to his retreat into the <style="highlight">Vaduso Mountains</style>, had explicitly advised me to observe Eomir's actions, suggesting an innate foresight.
say:8:1011517006:2.source_cn: 雅顿贤者退居<style=highlight>瓦度索山...
say:8:1011517006:2.male: Master Arden, prior to his retreat into the <style="highlight">Vaduso Mountains</style>, had explicitly advised me to observe Eomir's actions, suggesting an innate foresight.
say:8:1011517006:2.female: Master Arden, prior to his retreat into the <style="highlight">Vaduso Mountains</style>, had explicitly advised me to observe Eomir's actions, suggesting an innate foresight.

say:9:1011517007:0.text: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.
say:9:1011517007:0.source_cn: 否则便不会劝诫洛桑外出求援，也不会命我唤回埃隆。
say:9:1011517007:0.male: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.
say:9:1011517007:0.female: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.

choice_prompt:10:1011517007.text: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.
choice_prompt:10:1011517007.source_cn: 否则便不会劝诫洛桑外出求援，也不会命我唤回埃隆。
choice_prompt:10:1011517007.male: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.
choice_prompt:10:1011517007.female: Otherwise, he would not have urged Lorsan to seek external assistance, nor would he have tasked me with summoning Eironn back.

say:11:1011517008:0.text: Conveying and acquiring information is what we Windwhisperers do.
say:11:1011517008:0.source_cn: 传递和探听情报，这是风语者所长。
say:11:1011517008:0.male: Conveying and acquiring information is what we Windwhisperers do.
say:11:1011517008:0.female: Conveying and acquiring information is what we Windwhisperers do.

say:12:1011517009:0.text: Alas, our prolonged inability to reach Master Arden leaves us in the dark about his current status.
say:12:1011517009:0.source_cn: 但，我们久已联系不上雅顿贤者，不知有何情况。

say:14:1011517010:0.text: Is everything alright with Grandpa Arden...?
say:14:1011517010:0.source_cn: 雅顿老爷子，不会出了什么事吧……

say:15:1011517011:1.text: His situation remains obscure. I shall persist in attempting to establish contact with him. It is advisable for you to focus on the present circumstances.
say:15:1011517011:1.source_cn: 情况不明。我会继续联络，诸位还是聚焦于眼前之事为好。

say:16:1011517012:1.text: The Thorned Guards have erected a blockade around the Lucent Tree, indicating potential maneuvers by Eomir. Your attentiveness is implored.
say:16:1011517012:1.source_cn: 荆棘卫队已封锁流荧树周边，伊米尔恐怕要有行动。望诸位留意。

say:17:1011517013:1.text: Additionally, during Elona's investigative pursuits, anomalies were observed in the eastern Flower Grove and the northeastern forest.
say:17:1011517013:1.source_cn: 另外，艾洛娜搜寻诸位时，发现东部的奇花漫谷与东北方的森...

choice_prompt:18:1011517013.text: Additionally, during Elona's investigative pursuits, anomalies were observed in the eastern Flower Grove and the northeastern forest.
choice_prompt:18:1011517013.source_cn: 另外，艾洛娜搜寻诸位时，发现东部的奇花漫谷与东北方的森林，似乎也有异常。

say:21:1011517014:0.text: If those two places are corrupted too, doesn't that mean the corruption has basically taken over the entire Dark Forest?
say:21:1011517014:0.source_cn: ……等等，如果那两处也都是腐化，腐化岂不是已经遍布了整...

say:23:1011517016:0.text: Along with the corruption on the east and northeast, they've encircled the Lucent Tree!
say:23:1011517016:0.source_cn: 果然！再加上东边和东北，腐化就以流荧树为中心，环绕了整...

say:25:1011517017:0.text: This... This is <style="highlight">a big magic circle centered around the Lucent Tree</style>!

say:26:1011517018:0.text: Each corruption spot serves as a node for the magic circle, and once they are interconnected, the circle is complete!
say:26:1011517018:0.source_cn: 每一处腐化都是魔法阵的魔力节点，这样彼此联通之后，阵法...

choice_prompt:27:1011517018.text: Each corruption spot serves as a node for the magic circle, and once they are interconnected, the circle is complete!
choice_prompt:27:1011517018.source_cn: 每一处腐化都是魔法阵的魔力节点，这样彼此联通之后，阵法就成型了！

say:28:1011517019:0.text: Eomir has been living in the forest like the rest of us and knows little about magic...
say:28:1011517019:0.source_cn: 伊米尔和我们一样，一直生活在丛林中，对于魔法奥秘没有那...

say:29:1011517020:0.text: Creating a magic circle like this requires expertise of magic from the outside, along with a thorough knowledge of the forest.
say:29:1011517020:0.source_cn: 要布下这样的阵法，只有借助外来的魔法技艺，加上对丛林的...

say:30:1011517021:0.text: Although I'm not sure about the exact ties between Eomir, the Adamant Syndicate, and the Graveborn lady, and whether she's the "lady" Lorsan mentioned...
say:30:1011517021:0.source_cn: 虽然不知道亡灵女士，伊米尔，还有黑金商会的关系到底是什...

say:31:1011517022:0.text: At least those Syndicate people didn't lie to us about Eomir.
say:31:1011517022:0.source_cn: 至少那位黑金商会的先生，并没有在伊米尔的事情上欺骗我们。

say:34:1011517023:0.text: With all the evidence, there's no room for doubt...
say:34:1011517023:0.source_cn: ……是的。证据如此确凿，容不下任何怀疑。

say:35:1011517024:0.text: All this time, I've pledged my allegiance to the wrong person.
say:35:1011517024:0.source_cn: 一直以来，我都在向错误的人效忠。

choice_prompt:36:1011517024.text: All this time, I've pledged my allegiance to the wrong person.
choice_prompt:36:1011517024.source_cn: 一直以来，我都在向错误的人效忠。

say:37:1011517025:0.text: As a member of the Thorned Faction, my one and only duty is to protect the forest.
say:37:1011517025:0.source_cn: 我是荆棘。身为荆棘，我唯一的职责是守护丛林。
say:37:1011517025:0.male: As a member of the Thorned Faction, my one and only duty is to protect the forest.
say:37:1011517025:0.female: As a member of the Thorned Faction, my one and only duty is to protect the forest.

say:38:1011517026:0.text: This will never change, no matter what.
say:38:1011517026:0.source_cn: ……只有这点，无论如何也不会变。
say:38:1011517026:0.male: This will never change, no matter what.
say:38:1011517026:0.female: This will never change, no matter what.

say:41:1011517027:1.text: Bryon, time is of the essence; we've got to head out right now.
say:41:1011517027:1.source_cn: 布莱恩，事不宜迟，我们得立刻出发。

say:44:1011517028:1.text: Understood. I shall convey this information to Master Dahnie and the Dusk Patrollers.
say:44:1011517028:1.source_cn: 了解。我也会将信息告知达赫妮贤者和薄暮巡游队。

say:45:1011517029:1.text: May the winds of justice always be with you.
say:45:1011517029:1.source_cn: 愿明辨之风常伴诸位左右。

choice:27:0:1.source_cn: 这样看来，情况很明晰了

choice:27:1:2.text: Eomir is after the Lucent Tree.
choice:27:1:2.source_cn: 伊米尔的目标果然是流荧树
choice:27:1:2.male: Eomir is after the Lucent Tree.
choice:27:1:2.female: Eomir is after the Lucent Tree.

choice:10:0:1.source_cn: 这就是代表感知的风语……

say:4:1011518001:0.text: The Lucent Tree... the symbol of the Dark Forest, our sacred haven.
say:4:1011518001:0.source_cn: ……流荧树，薄暮丛林的象征，我们心中的神圣所在。

say:5:1011518002:1.text: I've often wondered, if I hadn't been born under your shade, would my life be any different?
say:5:1011518002:1.source_cn: 我曾想过，假如不是在你的树荫下降生，我的人生是否会有所不同？

say:6:1011518003:0.text: Even now, I still don't feel a connection with you... no divine revelation nor omen.
say:6:1011518003:0.source_cn: 即使到了现在，我依旧感觉不到和你的链接……既没有神启，...

say:7:1011518004:0.text: But, even so, I've come to realize my mission.
say:7:1011518004:0.source_cn: 不过，即便如此，我也已经了然自己的使命。

say:8:1011518005:0.text: Scion of the Lucent Tree or not, I am a member of the Dark Forest.
say:8:1011518005:0.source_cn: 无论是不是流荧树之子，我都是丛林的一员。

say:9:1011518006:0.text: It is time I wield my swords to protect you.
say:9:1011518006:0.source_cn: 我要用手中的剑，守护你。

narration:11:1011539:0.text: Amid the crisis, Eironn, as the Scion of the Lucent Tree, gazes at it for a long time.
narration:11:1011539:0.source_cn: 危机当前，作为流荧树之子的埃隆，久久地望着流荧树。

say:0:1011601001:0.text: So... What is the Flower Grove like?
say:0:1011601001:0.source_cn: 东方的奇花漫谷……那是什么地方？
say:0:1011601001:0.male: So... What is the Flower Grove like?
say:0:1011601001:0.female: So... What is the Flower Grove like?

say:1:1011601002:0.text: I've been there once. It's a serene valley adorned with beautiful orchids.
say:1:1011601002:0.source_cn: 是一座幽静深邃的山谷，我曾经去过一次，谷下开满了美丽的...
say:1:1011601002:0.male: I've been there once. It's a serene valley adorned with beautiful orchids.
say:1:1011601002:0.female: I've been there once. It's a serene valley adorned with beautiful orchids.

say:2:1011601003:0.text: I remember it's a long way from here.
say:2:1011601003:0.source_cn: 我记得从这里出发，要很远的路程。
say:2:1011601003:0.male: I remember it's a long way from here.
say:2:1011601003:0.female: I remember it's a long way from here.

subtitle:2:1011518101:.text: Cecia, you came at a bad time.
subtitle:2:1011518101:.source_cn: 瑟西娅，你来得不是时候

subtitle:2:1011518102:.text: Looks like you've got a bit of a problem.

subtitle:2:1011518103:.text: Will these people affect your plans?
subtitle:2:1011518103:.source_cn: 这几个人，会影响到你的计划么？

subtitle:2:1011518104:.text: What are you so worried about?

subtitle:2:1011518107:.text: make sure they don't trouble me.

subtitle:2:1011518109:.text: I'll tolerate you a little longer.
